purpose: Long-running maintenance plan for unattended repository work

long_term_goal.objective: Correctly diagnose and process every aircraft in the user's installed MSFS catalog wherever the package contains usable source data; explicitly identify missing or unsupported source features rather than guessing.
long_term_goal.cycle: Alternate compatibility work and GUI work; after every stage run a focused architecture/code review, record newly found issues, and update this roadmap before starting the next stage.

steps: run local checks and real-catalog measurement
wait for CI and merge without force-push
build and publish a versioned release when stage criteria are met
stage_workflow.release_rule: Use patch releases for user-visible compatible fixes and feature releases for a coherent larger capability; never label unmerged branch artifacts as a release.

stages.name: GitHub and documentation hygiene
stages.note: Repository documentation and release contents are clean; GitHub Wiki still needs its first page created in the GitHub UI before the wiki mirror can be pushed.

stages.name: Compatibility audit
stages.result: Added catalog --deep, corrected stale format documentation, added compatibility_report.py and a path-free compatibility snapshot.

stages.name: Resolver and format compatibility
stages.result: Deep catalog diagnostics are available in CLI and GUI; GLB is accepted by build plans; draw_mode=msfs incompatibility is rejected before Blender. B1-B4 transform/checkpoint fixes were verified with unit and headless Blender checks. Remaining B work is resolver edge-case hardening.

stages.name: GUI workflow and editors
stages.result: Added graphical controls for deep catalog diagnosis, normal_decode, converted_normal_dir, pose_position and repair_skin_roots; unified custom/system catalog callbacks. Existing rule editors and checkpoint workflow remain covered by regression tests.

stages.name: Release and portability
stages.result: Built and smoke-tested 1.2.1 Setup and Portable artifacts; docs and licenses are included and SHA256SUMS.txt was regenerated.

rolling_roadmap.name: Resolver edge-case hardening
focus: verify dependency diagnostics end to end
exit_criteria: full unit and GUI self checks
rolling_roadmap.result: Texture fallback ambiguity now lists all candidate package folders; unresolved diagnostics retain the original path instead of returning the string None. 150 unit tests, GUI self-test, compileall and diff check passed.

rolling_roadmap.name: Catalog identity and availability
focus: duplicate aircraft names across real packages and history stubs
exit_criteria: dedup policy is explicit and tested
rolling_roadmap.result: Actual catalog found one duplicate pair: buildable Asobo_DA62 and an empty fs-base-history placeholder. The placeholder is now reported separately, while unique history-only records and other same-name packages remain visible. Actual selection list reduced from 234 to 233; one suppressed record retained with shadowed_by. 153 unit tests, GUI self-test, compileall, Blender worker checks and diff checks passed.

rolling_roadmap.name: GUI diagnostics and recovery
focus: show dependency provenance and ambiguity clearly
audit checkpoint selection and error recovery
exit_criteria: no raw traceback for expected user input

rolling_roadmap.name: Format compatibility matrix
exit_criteria: each supported/rejected feature has a fixture and clear diagnosis
no unsupported feature is silently guessed

rolling_roadmap.name: Compatibility measurement and next release
focus: package bilingual docs and release artifacts

blocked_policy.after_limit: record blocker and evidence, stop guessing, continue independent tasks
blocked_policy.user_data_policy: do not request or upload MSFS aircraft or personal project files

resume.network_loss: keep local commit and resume from origin/main after reconnecting
resume.usage_limit: leave a clean commit, test result and next_step before stopping
